name: Forest of Lesbians
source:
The nymph Ellie has been studying in the human lands. During a short break she visits her forest with her friends. Trouble is brewing in the forest, its guardians restless. Can Ellie and her friends uncover the reason for this unrest? And more importantly, can Ellie protect her exotic girlfriend from the lustful inhabitants of the forest?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2462600/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
仙女艾莉一直在人类土地上学习。在短暂的休息期间，她和朋友们一起参观了她的森林。森林里正在酝酿着麻烦，森林的守护者们焦躁不安。艾莉和她的朋友们能找出这场骚乱的原因吗？更重要的是，艾莉能保护她的异国女友免受森林里好色的居民的侵害吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2462600/]Steam[/url]]
